capture.notes: Live BTicino F461 (firmware 2.0.11 / WHO 13 device type 200 / WHO 1013 134.15.5.0) multi-session bus capture of 2026-10-23 recorded with OWNd master on the physical test plant: BT-F411/4 lights at WHERE 06 and 07 (Group #1, General 0), an F422 interface with a light at WHERE 09 whose actuator lacked configurator 2 at capture time (it reports in the area sweep but answers no point command), BT-F411/2 5 s timed shutter at WHERE 05, Living Now KW4691 standalone thermostat at Zone 2 with a BT-F430/2 heating valve (actuator 1) and a BT-F430/4 fan coil (actuator 2); no central unit, no WHO 16 / 22 devices. Purpose: the physical evidence behind OWNd pull requests 136-142 and MyHOME pull requests 791-798 (oracle replay of 165 read-only requests, reviewer reads, setpoint restore, report-form writes, and the event-session bus while the fixed integration ran in a local Home Assistant). The *4*311*2## NACK / *4*311*#2## ACK pair cited by OWNd 137 is in the earlier capture of the same plant, tests/fixtures/traces/f461_live_2026-10-15 (run3_climate, probe_followup). Timing: t is one monotonic axis over all runs (capture.runs[].t_offset is each run's start; t - t_offset is the time since that run's first frame); command-session rx rows carry t_estimated = true because the session hands the replies over as a batch with the ACK / NACK, so they are placed at their request's t; result.events_after holds only the event-session frames that arrived while the request was pending (tx.t <= t <= result.t).

runs.purpose: 165 status / dimension requests mirrored from the firmware-oracle suites (WHO 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 8, 9, 13, 14, 16, 17, 18, 22, 25, 1001, 1013) plus 31 plant reads; read-only, no WHO 4 dimension 22, no report-form writes
address spellings *#1*0007## / *#1*07## / *#1*7##, humidity *#4*0*60## and *#4*2*60##, a WHO 22 read, *#13**0## echoed on the event session
*#4*2*#14*0235*3## restores the setpoint in force, then *#4*2## shows the reply order 0, 12, season, 14, 13
final plant state after the Home Assistant session: lights 06 / 07, cover 05, zone 2 (*#4*2## with dimension 12 = 21.0)
same reads two hours later: dimension 12 and 14 both 23.5 after the restore
report-form writes used by the expose engine: *#18*51*113*100## ACK (not echoed), *#4*#0*0*0215## NACK after the bus timeout (no central unit)

event session only, 1770 s listen while a local Home Assistant ran the integration under test: startup sweeps, *#4*#0*20## actuator replies after every reconnect, cover 05 runs, one *2*0*0## general stop, the spontaneous WHO 13 / 1013 frames at connect
event session only, bus monitor of the local Home Assistant session: light 06 / 07 toggles, cover 05 close / position / close, setpoint 22.0 then 21.0, the manual *#4*2*20## reply
re-sent *#25*21## and *#3*#1## after a 100 ms light pulse was seen during run1 at 20:42:07 UTC; not reproduced, the pulse came from elsewhere
second attempt with the WHO 22 reads that preceded the pulse in run1; not reproduced
